decisions.reason: Proven government use and over 30 APIS connections show its value has resolved favourably, so the firm should commit further rather than abandon it.

Post-pandemic demand for travel health information remains doubtful and no results have appeared, but the API is cheap to maintain and could be repurposed for travel requirement checks, so the option is still held, though only marginally.
Behaviour analysis is central to the firm's specialist detection capability and can be extended to new sectors, and its uncertainty is unresolved at little holding cost, so the option stays open.
Passenger profiling builds on core aviation security know-how and costs little to sustain while its value is still emerging, so keeping the option is justified.
The verification platform is close to the established offer and complements the passenger data products at low marginal cost, so it is retained while its results develop.
